entries.final_answer: Create-or-update (upsert): save creates the tactic when its id is unknown and replaces it when known. The filesystem adapter gains an atomic create arm (new file in the pack dir) alongside the existing atomic replace. Pinned by a port-level contract test covering both the create and the update arm. Write surface stays HTTP-unexposed this mission (C-006).
